text: It is said that a young warrior called Grissenda has vowed to recover a lost family relic. She was last seen in Northern Bluemist river, exploring some ruins.
Varsilia is a rich kingdom, but its roads are not safe. There's a rumor about bandits kidnapping a woman near Kingsbridge and dragging her to a cave.
Years ago, one of those Loreseekers from New Garand ventured into the Deadwood. She was never seen again.
Some monsters, like undead, are much stronger by night.
In Mercia there is slave trade, which makes other kingdoms nervous. But they don't enslave 'civilized' people, only Varannari savages, or convicts.
A group of Varannari hunters is now camping in South Sagar Forest. They can be dangerous, but normally they just go about their own business and sometimes you can trade with them.
It is said that a gem trader in Jabal is offering much better price for emeralds than usual. Maybe he is a wizard and uses them as reagents?
Goblins may seem puny and weak, but they can swarm you easily. And deep in the mountains, it's said they're bigger and stronger, so watch out!
Have you heard the good news? Some hero entered Lannegar Mine and defeated the goblins, including their Flamedancer leader. Now the mines have been reopened!
There is a strange vagabond wandering the streets of New Garand... He is huge, his face is deformed, and he seems to have lost his mind. The guards should lock him up.
It is said that goblins worshipped Fire Drakes and Red Dragons in the ancient days. Some even believe such creatures still live deep into Gorx Lair, north of Lannegar.
"Travellers from Föga talk about a crazed Mirmek enveloped in magic flames; it leveled the forests in the Iross Highlands, and hid in some cave there. "
Trolls are gruesome beasts, and very hard to kill. The only way to make sure they stop regenerating is burning them with fire.
Some nights ago there was quite a racket in New Garand. The watch pursued some burglars, but they escaped. Many say they went down into the sewers.
The word is, some smugglers in New Garand work outside of the control of the Seventh House. They must be nuts to do so, even if probably they hide outside the city.
A travelling troupe of Friguldian actors is performing in New Anthur. Their main actor, Laertes, is the favorite of the crowd.
The Church of the Three sent an expedition of crusaders against the undead of Great Inori, led by a young priestess called Hirge.
One of the finest alchemists in the Nivarian, Mallow Firebrew, went out of business recently. Word is, he is trying to rebuild his business, and seeks adventurers that bring him ingredients.
A group of adventures found a strange black shard after defeating a dragon. They sold it to the Friguld Governor for quite a sum, and now it's safely locked up in the Golden Cove Bank.
Something is rotten in Icemist. Arcane Captain Torden went missing, and there's rumors of other people disappearing every night.
The great Arena of Freetown has opened its gates! They are still trying to recuit gladiators aspiring to gain fame and fortune.
